No worker abstraction or state file exists. state/.cli holds only the first-run marker (state/.cli/first-run). cmd_bench_run prints one static line 'The Analyst is inspecting the client…' (bin/productteam:528). No strip, no four states, no file backing.

Loading is a static '…' line in chat (lib/repl.sh:110) and '…' in bench run (bin/productteam:528); completion is a single 'Recorded iter N — overall X' line (bin/productteam:579-580). No live spinner, no card.

But only 2 of 4 states have language: success=G (score_color bin/productteam:30-33, cmd_judge_set:322-340), error=RD (die bin/productteam:61, provider-refused lib/repl.sh:112). No progress or escalate state language exists anywhere.

Data accessors exist to build it (client_dir bin/productteam:62-73, latest_run 75-77, engagement_scorer 80-92, mode awk in cmd_judge 307-309, overall jq in cmd_bench 488-489) but nothing renders them in-session.
